title: Use AI MoCap to drive character performance from a video reference in Flow…
content:
Use AI MoCap to drive character performance from a video reference in Flow Studio.  
Use the 3D Editor to build your scene/world and control camera movement before generating.  
Use Canvas with Seedance 2.5 to refine and polish the final look after generation.
tips:
Use AI MoCap to drive character performance from a video reference in Flow Studio.  
Use the 3D Editor to build your scene/world and control camera movement before generating.  
Use Canvas with Seedance 2.5 to refine and polish the final look after generation.

es.content:
Usa AI MoCap para dirigir la interpretación del personaje a partir de una referencia de video en Flow Studio.  
Usa el Editor 3D para construir tu escena/mundo y controlar el movimiento de cámara antes de generar.  
Usa Canvas con Seedance 2.5 para refinar y pulir el aspecto final después de la generación.

fr.content:
Utilisez AI MoCap pour piloter la performance d’un personnage à partir d’une vidéo de référence dans Flow Studio.  
Utilisez l’éditeur 3D pour construire votre scène/votre univers et contrôler les mouvements de caméra avant la génération.  
Utilisez Canvas avec Seedance 2.5 pour affiner et peaufiner le rendu final après la génération.

ja.content:
Flow Studio で、動画リファレンスから AI MoCap を使ってキャラクターの演技を駆動します。  
3D Editor を使って、生成前にシーン／ワールドを構築し、カメラの動きを制御します。  
Canvas と Seedance 2.5 を使って、生成後に最終的な見た目を洗練し、仕上げます。

ko.content:
Flow Studio에서 비디오 레퍼런스를 바탕으로 AI MoCap을 사용해 캐릭터 퍼포먼스를 구현하세요.  
3D Editor를 사용해 생성 전에 씬/월드를 구성하고 카메라 움직임을 제어하세요.  
생성 후에는 Canvas와 Seedance 2.5를 사용해 최종 비주얼을 다듬고 완성도를 높이세요.

pt.content:
Use o AI MoCap para conduzir a performance do personagem a partir de uma referência em vídeo no Flow Studio.  
Use o Editor 3D para construir sua cena/mundo e controlar o movimento da câmera antes de gerar.  
Use o Canvas com o Seedance 2.5 para refinar e aprimorar o visual final após a geração.

zh.content:
使用 AI MoCap 在 Flow Studio 中通过视频参考驱动角色表演。  
使用 3D Editor 构建你的场景/世界，并在生成前控制镜头运动。  
使用 Canvas 搭配 Seedance 2.5，在生成后进一步打磨并优化最终效果。
